description: If a finite actual atom family has a unifier into any residual alphabet, the existing term-unification solver succeeds on its specified finite equation problem and its same returned substitution is a most general atom unifier.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderResolution.atom_unify_success.{u, v, w, w'} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  {α : Type w} (A : Finset (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HerbrandModels.Atom L ℕ)) (σ : ℕ → L.Term α)
  (h : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderResolution.AtomUnifies σ A) :
  ∃ μ,
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.TermUnification.unify
          (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderResolution.atomProblem A) =
        some μ ∧
      Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderResolution.AtomMGU A μ
